critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' geometry by applying a variable spacing array along the fuselage length. Instead of uniform placement, implement a parametric gap increase (ratio 1:2.5) centered on the door locations and cockpit area to match the reference layout. Additionally, duplicate the existing window primitive set and offset it vertically by 15% of the fuselage height to create the 'Upper deck' row.
